'''Xin Sun''' ({{zh|s=孙鑫}}) is a Chinese mathematician specializing in [[probability theory]] and [[mathematical physics]]. He is a professor of [[mathematics]] at [[Peking University]].<ref name=":1">{{Cite web |last=Sun |first=Xin |date= |title=Curriculum Vitae |url=https://faculty.bicmr.pku.edu.cn/~xinsun/CV.pdf |url-status= |access-date=2026-09-16 |website=Professor Xin Sun - Academic Profile}}</ref>

== Career ==
Sun graduated from Peking University in 2011 with a B.S. in mathematics. In 2017, he received his Ph.D. in mathematics from the [[Massachusetts Institute of Technology]], under the supervision of [[Scott Sheffield]].<ref name=":1" /> He was a Junior Fellow of the [[Simons Foundation|Simons Society of Fellows]] from 2017 to 2020, during which time he was a postdoctoral researcher at [[Columbia University]].<ref name=":1" /> From 2020 to 2023 he was a faculty member at the [[University of Pennsylvania]], and he was a visiting researcher at the [[Institute for Advanced Study]] from 2022 to 2023. As of 2023, he is a faculty member at [[Peking University]].<ref name=":1" /><ref>{{Cite web |date=2023-05-03 |title=Award-winning Chinese mathematician returns to Peking University from US |url=https://www.scmp.com/news/china/science/article/3219222/award-winning-chinese-mathematician-sun-xin-returns-us-work-peking-university |access-date=2026-09-16 |website=South China Morning Post |language=en}}</ref>

== Research ==
Sun studies random curves and surfaces and their connections with [[statistical mechanics]] and [[conformal field theory]]. His work explores, in particular, the relationships between [[Schramm–Loewner evolution]], Liouville quantum gravity and [[Liouville field theory|Liouville conformal field theory]].<ref>{{Cite web |date=2022-02-17 |title=Xin Sun {{!}} Scholars {{!}} Institute for Advanced Study |url=https://www.ias.edu/scholars/xin-sun |access-date=2026-09-16 |website=www.ias.edu |language=en}}</ref>

With [[Nina Holden]], Sun proved that uniformly sampled triangulations converge to a Liouville quantum gravity disk under a [[Conformal map|conformal embedding]], establishing joint convergence of distances, boundary lengths and areas.<ref name="cardy">{{cite journal |last1=Holden |first1=Nina |last2=Sun |first2=Xin |year=2023 |title=Convergence of uniform triangulations under the Cardy embedding |journal=Acta Mathematica |volume=230 |issue=1 |pages=93–203 |arxiv=1905.13207 |doi=10.4310/ACTA.2023.v230.n1.a2}}</ref>

With Pierre Nolin, Wei Qian and Zijie Zhuang, Sun derived an exact expression for the [[Percolation critical exponents|backbone exponent]] of critical [[Percolation theory|site percolation]] on the triangular lattice. This exponent describes how the probability of two disjoint open paths crossing an annulus decays as the annulus becomes thicker. They proved that it is a [[transcendental number]], whereas all previously known percolation arm exponents were rational.<ref name="quanta">{{cite news |last=Sloman |first=Leila |date=2024-02-07 |title=Maze Proof Establishes a ‘Backbone’ for Statistical Mechanics |url=https://www.quantamagazine.org/maze-proof-establishes-a-backbone-for-statistical-mechanics-20240207/ |work=Quanta Magazine}}</ref><ref name="backbone">{{cite arXiv |eprint=2309.05050 |class=math.PR |first1=Pierre |last1=Nolin |first2=Wei |last2=Qian |title=Backbone exponent for two-dimensional percolation |last3=Sun |first3=Xin |last4=Zhuang |first4=Zijie |year=2023}}</ref>

== Awards and recognition ==
Sun received the [[Bernoulli Society for Mathematical Statistics and Probability|Bernoulli Society]] New Researcher Award in 2020.<ref>{{cite web |title=Previous New Researcher Award Recipients |url=https://www.bernoullisociety.org/index.php/prizes/15-features/278-past-new-researcher |publisher=Bernoulli Society |access-date=18 September 2026}}</ref>
He received the [[Rollo Davidson Prize]] in 2023, given "for leading work on random planar maps and Liouville quantum gravity",<ref name="rollo">{{cite web |date=2023-05-16 |title=Rollo Davidson Prizes |url=https://imstat.org/2023/05/16/rollo-davidson-prizes/ |website=Institute of Mathematical Statistics}}</ref> and the Frontiers of Science Award in Mathematics in 2024.<ref name="frontiers">{{cite web |title=Frontiers of Science Awards |url=https://2024.icbs.cn/site/pages/index/index?pageId=2cd3eaea-5f56-4cb1-9276-5a3a9ca39223 |access-date=2026-09-16 |website=2024 International Congress of Basic Science}}</ref> Sun was an invited speaker at the 2026 [[International Congress of Mathematicians]].<ref name="icm">{{cite web |title=ICM 2026 Speakers |url=https://www.icm2026.org/event/ac193975-5d24-4628-8c30-ddb23de19a8b/speakers?environment=P2 |access-date=2026-09-16 |website=International Congress of Mathematicians 2026}}</ref>
